fusions.name: Cloud Burst
fusions.desc: Looses a cloud of locusts in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 20% chance per hit to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Sends a locust that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, heals you for 20% of the damage dealt and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Gnawing Cloud
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 5 seconds. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Strip the Field
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 4% more damage per stack (22% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
